decisions.reason: As a core next-generation high-resolution printer closely tied to the firm’s main coding hardware business, it fits the growing market and the firm’s expansion strategy.
The numbering software supports variable-data printing and traceability, though as a narrower software module it has a slightly higher rationalization risk than core hardware.
A coder for non-absorbent surfaces directly extends the firm’s established marking offer across more applications and is likely to remain commercially useful.
The code-decoding app supports digitalization and traceability, but as a non-core mobile product it is more exposed to discontinuation if adoption or strategic value disappoints.
Inline code verification is strongly aligned with compliance, serialization and end-to-end traceability, making it a strategically important complement to the installed base.
Print layout design software reinforces the firm’s one-stop system approach and common operation across machines, so it is likely to be retained.
